svg.title: Output contract across 12 synthetic tasks
svg.desc: A one-shot draft met the answer.json output contract for 6 tasks; its other 6 outputs held the correct value but omitted the required answer wrapper. B checked loop and C Nisi workflow each met the contract for all 12 after one repair opportunity. One local Gemma endpoint; exploratory repeated-task pilot. Result SHA-256 17c117821d347bf4ad248b70b319d8847bbedc2647edebf6b0a2e8edf996b10a; frozen dataset SHA-256 cef0921e2104650b4c7f1f5f0612379d35bbe393c6152811f9236543a8a20a40.
